canDo: Can identify the author’s or characters’ opinions, reasons, examples and concessions.
output: Draw a map of the argument; restate the opinions aloud.
checkpoint: Can tell facts, opinions and examples apart.
challenge: Today’s challenge: first do a set of connector exercises on « exprimer son opinion » at Le Point du FLE, then pick a social news story in RFI’s « Journal en français facile » and draw its “position – reasons – examples – concession” map; finally write one emphatic sentence each with Ce qui me frappe, c'est… and C'est… qui… to give your view of the story.

questions.why: The ending states this reason explicitly.

V34-01.exZh: Supporters of free travel put forward the environmental argument.

V34-02.exZh: Opponents put forward another argument: the service would get worse.

V34-03.zh: that’s actually the very reason why …
V34-03.exZh: That’s true, and that’s actually the very reason why I keep going.

V34-04.exZh: A measure defended with a false argument ends up being judged on that argument.

V34-05.exZh: The idea is appealing, except that budgets aren’t interchangeable.

V34-06.zh: to point to someone to blame
V34-06.exZh: This option is attractive because it points to someone outside to blame.

V34-07.exZh: What I dispute is the idea that free information is just as good.

V34-08.exZh: I hear you, but I’m not going to pay eight euros a month.

V34-09.zh: to inspire (young people) to take something up
V34-09.exZh: People often reply that medals inspire young people to take up sport.

V34-10.exZh: The main objection is that a modern intervention ages badly.

V34-11.zh: overnight, from one day to the next

V34-12.exZh: About thirty French cities have made their transport network free.

V34-13.exZh: One might be tempted to see it as a local anecdote.

V34-14.zh: the usual talk, a conventional line
V34-14.exZh: I’d like to avoid the usual talk about young people no longer getting involved.

V34-15.zh: What seems right to me is …
V34-15.exZh: What seems right to me is a third argument that is rarely made.

V34-16.exZh: The available data don’t support the environmental argument.

V34-17.exZh: Opponents say that free travel deprives the network of funds.

V34-18.exZh: Cutting these funds doesn’t redirect them: it makes them disappear.

V34-19.exZh: Meanwhile, the number of people living in the centre fell by 22%.

V34-20.exZh: The cities that used this lever are getting results.

V34-21.exZh: Volunteering builds connections between people, which an administrative service doesn’t.

V34-22.exZh: A public service cuts staff, and an association is set up.

V34-23.zh: to get a lasting benefit from it
V34-23.exZh: Cities that keep using their facilities get a lasting benefit from them.

V34-24.exZh: These funds come largely from private partnerships.

V34-25.exZh: I’d rather say it than keep up an illusion.

V34-26.exZh: School alone won’t manage to rebuild a community of speakers.

V34-27.exZh: Reversibility is a non-negotiable condition for me.

V34-29.exZh: He refuses to subscribe to the local paper.

V34-30.exZh: According to the author, the debate on free travel is badly framed.

V34-31.exZh: The author believes that free travel is above all a social measure.

V34-32.exZh: Few people make this argument: free travel is an effective social measure.

V34-33.zh: to come out in favour of …
V34-33.exZh: The author comes out in favour of free public transport.

V34-34.exZh: The president qualifies what she says: volunteering is still useful.

V34-35.exZh: The figures help put things in perspective.

V34-36.exZh: Some employees are asking for flexible hours.

V34-37.exZh: With these hours, I save time on travel.

V34-38.exZh: The trouble is that some employees prefer fixed hours.

V34-39.exZh: We need to find common ground before the new term.

V34-40.exZh: Protests against mass tourism are increasing.

V34-41.exZh: Short-term rentals push up rents in the centre.

V34-42.zh: to get involved in an association
V34-42.exZh: People in their thirties get involved in associations, but only in short projects.

V34-44.exZh: The association supports isolated elderly people.

V34-45.exZh: We must distinguish between a freely chosen commitment and a right.
